authority: Codex adopted reviewer0061 proposal for the new research protocol; not a new user quality budget, not old-data acceptance
sourceScope: Only fixed model and prospective paths; no new native evidence or old observed event rescore
detector: D unchanged: adjacent absolute delta>=0.3px, consecutive same-sign transitions, accumulated absolute delta>=1.2px
eventRepresentative: StartY: first changed screen row; do not choose best row from event interval after seeing data
phase: u(x,y)=N*(x+beta*(x-anchor)-L(y))/W(y)+c; same frozen0039 parameters; unwrapped absolute phase, no nearest-integer modulo
predictedIdentity: Exact integer threshold crossed by floor(u) in the frozen control; negative sign uses old index, positive sign uses new index

match.assignment: Monotone one-to-one maximum-cardinality matching, then minimum sum absolute phase error; deterministic skip-observed/skip-predicted/match tie order
match.rowError: Reported diagnostic only; no fixed15row acceptance

perEdgeGate.denominator: All observed D-events and all predicted mandatory-body thresholds on each edge. Extra, opposite-sign or duplicated events remain in observed denominator.

completeness: Missing/invalid/out-of-order/duplicate mandatory section or frame/trace/protocol failure -> INCOMPLETE before detection/matching; no denominator removal
centeredLines: Primary new mechanism observation: both LongLeft/LongRight, zero D-events on BOTH edges across all767 mandatory body sections. This alone is not exact-width, Solid or product B certification.
controls: Secondary nonvacuity/phase-consistency observation. Report each edge separately; a failed control cannot promote the overall research result. Final whole-study aggregation remains to be frozen in runnable protocol.
